purpose: Record a reusable, explicitly non-canonical hypothesis for interpreting HeartFetter ConditionType=7 while authoritative runtime evaluator evidence is unavailable.

hypothesis.statement: For HeartFetter Lv4/Lv7 Buff records with ConditionType=7, each ConditionParam value is an explicit JobInfo.ID identifying the job/class under which that buff effect is intended to activate.
confidenceBasis: All 1,158 observed ConditionType=7 params resolve to JobInfo.ID and belong to the same frozen hero's explicit normal/SP job set.
All 267 frozen heroes have ConditionType=7 evidence at both HeartFetter Lv4 and Lv7.
Hero 144 provides source-description evidence that explicitly names job activation and matches ConditionParam JobInfo IDs 126 and 307.
Published class-specific HeartFetter presentation and historical semantic-lineage evidence support a job/class relationship.
unresolvedDetails: The exact runtime comparator or evaluator branch for ConditionType=7 is not directly observed.
Whether the runtime checks current active job, a derived class state, or an equivalent internal job predicate remains unproven.
This hypothesis must not be treated as proof of generic runtime implementation details beyond the job/class activation relation.

reopenConditions: A post-HeartFetter runtime evaluator contradicts job/class activation semantics.
A current source-pack record with ConditionType=7 has a ConditionParam that does not resolve to the same hero's explicit JobInfo set.
A source/contract/schema change invalidates the referenced validation evidence.
completion: A high-confidence, non-canonical CT7 job-activation hypothesis is recorded for research reuse without changing Hero canonical relations or production consumers.
